author: Iylahoh
quote: Cuck simulator. This is absolute extreme feminist left agenda in a video game. GTA, of all games! I was never really the biggest fan of Rockstar games. However, I thoroughly enjoyed GTA V when it first came out and Red Dead Redemption 2 was revolutionary at the time being a cinematic movie style you can play. Rockstar saw how successful RDR2 was so they copy pasted it. A multi billion dollar game? Really? And that’s what we get? Same clunky mechanics and game play. But the story line is the worst. Extremely boring. Doing chores I already do in real life and maintaining an e-girlfriend relationship I don’t care about. This just spells out virtue signaling for men to become simps and do whatever your girlfriend says. We can clearly see the 99/100 score were bought out to promote more hype so investors can collect money and not be in the hole on this one. Absolute garbage ****. Leave politics out of video games. Glad I was able to get a refund and will never give Rockstar any of my money.
